entities.name: Rook Ashbreaker
entities.concept: A disciplined siege specialist built around opening fortified routes and punishing clustered enemies.
entities.signature_mechanic: Breach Charge places one directional demolition node that damages structures more than characters and opens alternate assault lanes.
counterplay: Charges are visible, delayed, and limited.
entities.visual_identity: Ash-grey exosuit with orange demolition braces and a folding ram pack.
entities.animation_profile: Heavy planted throws and shoulder-braced breach detonations.
entities.vfx_profile: Compact directional blast cones, debris-limited structure cracks, orange warning grid.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Sera Nine-Lives
entities.concept: A reckless field medic who converts near-death rescues into short windows of mobility and overshield support.
entities.signature_mechanic: Last Thread grants a rescued ally a brief escape-speed burst and temporary directional overshield.
counterplay: Long rescue cooldown; cannot chain repeatedly on one ally.
entities.visual_identity: White-black trauma armor with red ribbon monitors and compact drone satchel.
entities.animation_profile: Fast slide-to-kneel rescue sequence with one-handed sidearm cover.
entities.vfx_profile: Red pulse ribbons, compact shield fan, low-noise medical drone lights.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Bront Vale, Chainrunner
entities.concept: A high-mobility bruiser using chained hooks to interrupt lesser monsters and pull himself toward large targets.
entities.signature_mechanic: Chain Vault hooks eligible terrain or enemies and converts the pull into a guarded leap attack.
counterplay: Hook line is visible and can miss; bosses resist pull.
entities.visual_identity: Bronze chain harness, asymmetric shoulder plate, twin retracting hooks.
entities.animation_profile: Wide pendulum swings and low landing braces.
entities.vfx_profile: Bronze arc trails, hook sparks, concise impact rings.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Ilyra Mosswake
entities.concept: A wilderness tracker who reveals ambush routes and seeds temporary restorative patches after clearing monster dens.
entities.signature_mechanic: Mossmark highlights nearby eligible hidden threats and turns cleared lairs into short-lived rest nodes.
counterplay: Reveal radius is local; rest nodes expire and cannot be stacked.
entities.visual_identity: Green-black scout leathers with living moss mantle and antler sensor rig.
entities.animation_profile: Low stalking locomotion and hand-to-ground tracking gestures.
entities.vfx_profile: Soft spore trails, green outline pings, moss growth on cleared ground.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Kestrel Vox
entities.concept: A precision gunner specializing in hostile flyers and leap-heavy monsters.
entities.signature_mechanic: Skylock accumulates aim on airborne targets and triggers a brief slow/stagger on a clean burst.
counterplay: Grounded targets gain no special effect; lock breaks on cover.
entities.visual_identity: Slim cobalt armor with winglike optic fins and long anti-air rifle.
entities.animation_profile: Measured kneeling aim posture and upward snap tracking.
entities.vfx_profile: Blue tracking brackets and clean contrail-cut impacts.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Dax Cinderjaw
entities.concept: A frontliner who stores limited heat from enemy fire and vents it as controlled frontal denial.
entities.signature_mechanic: Furnace Guard absorbs selected fire-type pressure into a capped heat meter and vents a cone burst.
counterplay: Non-fire damage bypasses storage; overheat forces cooldown.
entities.visual_identity: Black furnace plate with glowing jaw grille and piston shoulders.
entities.animation_profile: Slow shielded advance, chest vents opening during release.
entities.vfx_profile: Orange heat bands, cone shimmer, capped ember spray.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Tala Hush
entities.concept: A silent infiltrator who marks enemy patrol routes and briefly suppresses her own detection footprint.
entities.signature_mechanic: Dead Route predicts short patrol paths for eligible AI and highlights low-risk crossing windows.
counterplay: Does not hide the squad from alert enemies; effect is local and temporary.
entities.visual_identity: Matte indigo cloak with folding map-light panels and masked face.
entities.animation_profile: Low-profile crouch movement, finger-sign commands, cloak cinch before stealth.
entities.vfx_profile: Faint indigo route lines and minimal shimmer to avoid visual noise.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Orren Pike
entities.concept: A pragmatic hunter that applies species-specific debuffs after observing a creature long enough.
entities.signature_mechanic: Hunter's Read identifies one eligible monster family weakness and applies a modest squad damage utility mark.
counterplay: Requires observation time; mark is family-specific and limited.
entities.visual_identity: Weathered hunter armor with trophy tags and collapsible spear-rifle.
entities.animation_profile: Observational idle, notebook gesture, quick spear transitions.
entities.vfx_profile: Amber weak-point sigils and trap wire glints.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Mara Coil
entities.concept: An engineer who deploys one reusable arc pylon to control chokepoints and power nearby devices.
entities.signature_mechanic: Arc Nest chains low damage between nearby lesser enemies and boosts selected allied deployables.

entities.visual_identity: Industrial yellow-black rig with coil backpack and insulated gloves.
entities.animation_profile: Two-step pylon unfold and cable-snap activation.
entities.vfx_profile: Blue-white short arcs, visible radius ring, low-cost sparks.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Fen Glassknife

entities.signature_mechanic: Shatterstep grants one empowered riposte after a qualified near-miss dodge.

entities.visual_identity: Mirror-edged coat armor, glass sabre, compact pistol.
entities.animation_profile: Elegant lateral dodges into one precise reverse-grip strike.
entities.vfx_profile: Silver fracture afterimage and narrow riposte flash.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Vela Runehook

entities.signature_mechanic: Counterseal marks one eligible hostile construct, increasing team damage and slowing its pulse rate.

entities.visual_identity: Dark teal utility armor with hanging rune keys and hook staff.
entities.animation_profile: Quick hook-and-stamp motion on marked constructs.
entities.vfx_profile: Teal counter-runes, pulse slowdown visualization.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Garrick Floodstep

entities.visual_identity: Blue-grey amphibious plate with finned boots and water-shedding cloak.
entities.animation_profile: Low hydroplane sprint and shoulder-first rush.
entities.vfx_profile: Water-slice trails, compact spray fan, blue momentum gauge.

entities.name: Cassian Rime, White Reaver
entities.concept: A legendary commander who turns frozen terrain into tactical lanes and cover rather than merely slowing enemies.
entities.signature_mechanic: Rimefront raises a moving line of temporary ice bulwarks that advances with the squad.

entities.visual_identity: White steel armor with blue fur mantle and hovering frost shards.
entities.animation_profile: Slow commanding walk with sweeping blade gestures that lift cover in sequence.
entities.vfx_profile: Tall ice sheets, drifting frost ribbons, fracture shards with distance culling.

entities.name: Amani Red Comet

entities.visual_identity: Crimson flight armor with comet-tail cape and segmented spear.
entities.animation_profile: Explosive takeoffs, spiral dives, three distinct spear landing recoveries.
entities.vfx_profile: Red ion trails, comet sparks, circular landing shock.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Lucent Marrow

entities.visual_identity: Ivory-gold battle vestments with floating censer blades.
entities.animation_profile: Measured censer arcs and grounded seal-stamping motions.
entities.vfx_profile: Gold-white sanctification rings, ash-to-light dissolve, subtle incense trails.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Dread Captain Sol Korr
entities.concept: A combat driver who boosts squad vehicle handling and can perform one emergency field repair per encounter.
entities.signature_mechanic: War Rig Command grants nearby allied vehicles improved recovery and activates a capped repair burst.
counterplay: Strongest only near vehicles; repair has encounter cooldown.
entities.visual_identity: Black-red convoy armor with holographic steering gauntlet and shoulder radio mast.
entities.animation_profile: Aggressive lean-in driver posture and rapid mechanical repair sequence.
entities.vfx_profile: Red route arrows, welding sparks, vehicle aura bands.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Eris Pale Choir

entities.visual_identity: Pale silver armor with resonant throat collar and ribbon-like speaker fins.
entities.animation_profile: Combat gestures resemble conducting, with visible three-beat phrasing.
entities.vfx_profile: Concentric pale wave rings, note geometry, low particle density.
entities.audio_profile: Unique hire, danger, command, ultimate, downed, and retreat cues with spatially readable combat audio.

entities.name: Torvex, Iron Oracle

entities.visual_identity: Massive gunmetal armor with rotating prediction lenses around the head.
entities.animation_profile: Slow lens alignment followed by an immovable shield-plant posture.
entities.vfx_profile: Amber forecast arcs and one directional metallic barrier.

entities.name: Kharon Vell, Ferryman of Wounds

entities.visual_identity: Tall black ferryman coat, chain oar, face hidden by dim lantern hood.

entities.signature_mechanic: Star Maw stores eligible projectile energy up to a strict cap and fires a single compressed retaliation sphere.
counterplay: Capture cap is low; beam/continuous attacks bypass it; telegraphed overload window.
entities.visual_identity: Midnight robe-armor with a tiny dark star hovering above one palm.
entities.animation_profile: Captured shots visibly orbit her before collapsing into the palm and releasing forward.

entities.name: Malach Rift-Tongue

entities.signature_mechanic: Tongue of Denial records an eligible enemy signature and imposes a short lockout after the enemy uses it again.

entities.visual_identity: Tall split-mask warlock with ribbon-like glyph tongue and hooked staff.

entities.name: Thessa Worldscar

entities.signature_mechanic: Worldscar cleaves a temporary breach line through eligible environmental blockers and staggers lesser enemies touching the line.

entities.visual_identity: Stone-black greatsword armor with glowing tectonic seams.
entities.animation_profile: Slow overhead draw followed by a full-body earth-splitting release.
entities.vfx_profile: Orange-white fault line, lifted debris ribbons, restrained ground fracture.

entities.name: Nemea, Queen of Strays
entities.concept: A mythic hunt queen who maintains a small temporary pack assembled from eligible local wildlife rather than summoning arbitrary creatures.

entities.visual_identity: Royal hunt armor with living fur mantle and crown of mismatched beast sigils.

entities.name: Quillon Elsewhere

entities.signature_mechanic: Elsewhere Window opens two linked sight apertures that allow a limited number of shots to exit from the paired angle.

entities.visual_identity: Iridescent geometric coat with floating monocle portals.
